facts.text: The JCC lists accessible parking, push-button door openers at the entrance and first-floor bathrooms, and elevator access to all floors. It does not give parking-space locations, door widths or a measured continuous route.
facts.quote: Our building features accessible parking, push button door openers on the entrance and the first-floor bathrooms, and elevator access to all floors.

facts.text: The family locker room provides space for assistance with changing or showering. The JCC explicitly says it does not currently have adult changing tables; confirm any transfer or personal-care arrangements before visiting.
facts.quote: We have a family locker room that allow space to assist with changing ( please note we do not currently have adult changing tables ) or showering as needed.

facts.text: Sensory kits with noise-reducing headphones, fidgets and other sensory items can be requested at the Welcome Desk. The FAQ says members and guests may borrow sensory bags from the front desk; availability is not quantified.
quote: Our sensory kits are equipped with noise-reducing headphones, a variety of fidgets, and other sensory items to meet the diverse needs of our guests. Request to borrow a Sensory Kit at the Welcome Desk
Sensory bags are available for members and guests to borrow from the front desk for members needing assistance managing their sensory needs while enjoying community programming at the J.

facts.text: The J Cafe offers Braille menus on request. A 3D-printed QR code at the register links to a plain-text online menu.
facts.quote: The J Cafe offers braille menus upon request for customers to use. There is also a 3D-printed QR code that sits on the J Cafe register for customers to scan and access a plain-text menu online.

facts.text: To request an event accommodation, contact the program staff listed on its JLive registration or website page. If contact information is missing or the question is more detailed, the inclusion team can help; its published phone is 513-644-0713.
quote: If you are attending a program at the JCC and need an accommodation to participate, please email the staff member listed as the contact for that program. You can find their contact information on the JLive registration or website page related to the program. If you do not see contact information or have a more detailed question, please email [email protected] to connect with the Inclusion Coordinator.
Please reach out to our Inclusion department via the web form below, phone at 513.644.0713

facts.text: Examples of accommodations that visitors can discuss include ASL interpreting, captioning, sensory bags, reserved seating and social narratives or advance event agendas. These are request options, not a guarantee that each service is available for every program.
quote: Some examples of common accommodations are: ASL interpreting or captioning, use of sensory bags, reserved seating, and a social narrative or early access to the event agenda.
We encourage you to contact us to discuss your accessibility needs and supports needed to ensure your participation in JCC programs.

facts.text: For off-site programs, the JCC works within the host venue’s policies and capabilities and says it cannot guarantee every accommodation request. Check the registration page and contact the listed program staff about the specific location.
quote: Registration pages for all JCC events, on or off-site, should include information about any universal accessibility features available at the location such as parking and elevator access. When renting a space, we work within the policies and capabilities of the space and therefore cannot guarantee all accommodation requests will be fulfilled.
If you have questions about the accessibility of an event or need to request an accommodation, please reach out to the listed staff or email our Inclusion Coordinator

facts.text: The Fitness & Friends and Adapted Basketball descriptions expect participants to engage independently or with their own personal-care assistant. Adapted Total Body Workout similarly expects independent participation or help from the participant’s own direct-support professional; do not assume personal care is supplied.
quote: FITNESS & FRIENDS Ages 16+ Sundays, 1 - 3pm J Members: FREE | Public: $25 This engaging adaptive class offers low-impact exercise, socializing, and creative crafts. Participants should be able to engage independently or with the help of their own personal care assistant.

ADAPTED BASKETBALL Ages 18+ Every Other Thursday, 7 - 8pm J Members: FREE | Public: $25 In this exciting, team-focused exercise class, participants will work on basketball fundamentals while socializing and being active. Participants should be able to engage independently or with the help of their own personal care assistant.

ADAPTED TOTAL BODY WORKOUT Age 16+ Wednesdays, 7 - 8pm J Members: FREE | Public: $25 This inclusive adapted workout combines cardio and strength training in a circuit format, with stretching and yoga for a total body workout. Participants should be able to engage independently or with the help of their own direct support professional.

facts.text: The inclusion page links visual preparation guides for the JCC locker rooms, private swim lessons, theater visits and selected programs. Use the guide for the actual program and check its date; off-site guides describe other venues.
